description: This PHP script defines functions for handling additional details display for 'Cases' within a SuiteCRM module. It constructs an overlay string with the case description and resolution, limited to 300 characters each, and provides links for editing and viewing the case details.

methods.name: additionaldetailscase
methods.description: Calls 'additionalDetailsaCase' to generate the overlay string for a case, based on input fields.

methods.name: additionalDetailsaCase
methods.description: Generates a formatted overlay string with 'Description' and 'Resolution' fields from the input, each truncated to 300 characters, with appropriate labels and links for editing and viewing the case.
